Experimental development prerelease. This is not a production-ready release.
Back up the vault and sync state before testing; install and verify on one device
at a time. A connected status does not establish that all devices received the
same data. Concurrent edits, mobile background sync, migration and rollback
require further validation. See the repository README for current limitations.

Plugin files are delivered as individual GitHub release assets for BRAT; sync
credentials and per-device configuration are not part of these assets.
